name: V Rising
description: V Rising dedicated server, installed anonymously with SteamCMD. Its settings and saves live in the save-data folder of the server.

variables.label: Description
variables.description: Shown under the name in the server list.

variables.label: World
variables.description: Its name: a new name makes a new world.

variables.label: Join password
variables.description: Players need it to join. Leave empty for a public server.

variables.label: Game mode
variables.description: With a ruleset, it must match the ruleset.

variables.label: Difficulty
variables.description: A ready-made difficulty. It overrides the custom game options; leave it empty to use them.

variables.label: Resource yield

variables.description: Multiplier of how many items fit in a stack. 1 is the game's own. Ignored while a ruleset or a difficulty is set.

variables.description: Multiplier of the players' maximum health. 1 is the game's own. Ignored while a ruleset or a difficulty is set.

variables.label: Damage players take
variables.description: Multiplier of any damage players receive. 1 is the game's own. Ignored while a ruleset or a difficulty is set.

variables.label: Enemy health
variables.description: Multiplier of the health of standard enemies. 1 is the game's own. Ignored while a ruleset or a difficulty is set.

variables.label: Enemy damage
variables.description: Multiplier of the damage standard enemies deal. 1 is the game's own. Ignored while a ruleset or a difficulty is set.

variables.label: Boss health
variables.description: Multiplier of the health of V Blood bosses. 1 is the game's own. Ignored while a ruleset or a difficulty is set.

variables.label: Boss damage
variables.description: Multiplier of the damage V Blood bosses deal. 1 is the game's own. Ignored while a ruleset or a difficulty is set.

variables.label: Admin slots
variables.description: Admins who can join even when the server is full.

variables.description: Target frames per second of the server. 30 is the game's own.
